description: Send a draft campaign. This DELIVERS real mail, one individual email per pending recipient, so confirm with the user before calling. This is the only campaign tool that sends. Recipients on the workspace's unsubscribe list are never mailed, every message carries its own unsubscribe link, and the send counts against the plan's monthly quota. Fails up front if the pending recipients wouldn't fit in the remaining quota, rather than sending to half the list. Delivery runs in the background in batches. Poll list_campaign_recipients or list_campaigns for progress.
